corrections.reason: The plural subject 'ሊቃነ ካህናት ወጸሐፍት' requires the 3rd person masculine plural verb 'ወየኃሥሡ' (2nd order ሡ), which is visible on the page.
The Ge'ez numeral for twelve is 'ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ'; the character following 'ዘእም-' is 'ዐ' (ዘእምዐሠርቱ), which was misread as 'ነ'.
The Ge'ez noun 'ኍልቅ' with the 3rd person masculine singular pronominal suffix '-ኡ' forms 'ኍልቁ' ('his number', translated as 'ቍጥሩ' in L03), and the 2nd order 'ቁ' is visible in the print.
The printed word is the standard Amharic 'እንዲህ' with 3rd order 'ዲ' (horizontal foot serif), not 5th order 'ዴ'.
The glyph has the 5th order ring 'ሄ' ('ሄዳችሁ') rather than 3rd order 'ሂ'.
